name: pathway-ai
description: Pathway AI — an AI companion that helps high school students get more out of their high school years.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push --workspace apps/api && npm run db:seed --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
